title: GRAD-MATCH: Gradient Matching based Data Subset Selection for Efficient Deep Model Training

anchors.paraphrase_zh: GradMatch 直接优化加权子集梯度与训练或验证目标梯度之间的二范数误差，并以子集大小 k 约束集合。
主实验包含与子集预算相同的随机选择，并另设按墙钟或能耗匹配的完整数据 early-stop 基线。
作者分别检验刷新间隔、批级近似、warm start、正则强度与训练阶段比例，说明方法效果依赖训练时机与近似配置。
批级版本直接使用被选批次，没有额外打乱或增强采样；作者把这些覆盖改进留给未来工作。

formulas: Err(w,X,L,L_T,theta_t) = ||sum_{i in X} w_i grad L_i^T(theta_t) - grad L(theta_t)||_2
OMP greedily adds the coordinate with the largest absolute residual correlation and refits weights
algorithm_steps: Choose whether the target is the full training gradient or an independent validation gradient.
At each refresh epoch, compute individual or mini-batch gradient embeddings and run orthogonal matching pursuit under subset size k and tolerance epsilon.
Train for the next R epochs on the weighted selected subset, then recompute the model-state-dependent subset.
Use optional last-layer, per-class, per-gradient, per-batch and warm-start approximations to control memory and wall-clock cost.
variables: weighted subset X and weights w
selection_timing: Adaptive selection is recomputed every R epochs; main experiments set R=20 and warm variants allocate part of the training schedule to full-data warm start.
refresh_rule: The OMP-selected weighted subset replaces the previous subset at each refresh and remains fixed between refreshes; the model parameters determine every later selection.

budget.unit: active subset fraction or selected mini-batch count per epoch
budget.denominator: full training-set size, with budgets of 1-10% on MNIST, 5-30% on ImageNet, and 5-30% on most other datasets
budget.unique_sample_definition: Point-level variants select at most k distinct examples per refresh; per-batch variants select whole existing mini-batches.
budget.repeat_definition: Selected identities are repeatedly trained during the R-epoch interval and may reappear after later refreshes; per-sample repeat parity is not enforced against random.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Main comparisons keep epoch counts fixed while subset epochs contain fewer optimizer-visible examples, so total exposure and optimizer steps differ from full training and are not a Stage1 fixed-replay budget.
budget.compute_cost: Gradient construction, OMP and subset training are included in wall-clock and energy comparisons; last-layer and per-batch approximations reduce selection cost and memory.

random_baselines: uniform random subset with points equal to the target budget
full-data early stopping matched approximately on time or energy

counts: 5 independent runs for reported mean accuracies
seed_count.aggregation: The paper reports mean accuracies after five runs and standard deviations in Appendix C.5.

checkpoint_selection: Main comparisons use fixed 200, 300 or 350 epoch schedules; one explicitly separate CIFAR-100 experiment extends GradMatch by 30-50 epochs rather than silently selecting a best checkpoint.

results.claim: GradMatch-PB-Warm 在多个子集比例上取得较好的精度与训练成本折中。
results.value: CIFAR-10 reports 7x, 4.2x and 3x speedups at 10%, 20% and 30% subsets with 2.8%, 1.5% and 0.9% accuracy drops

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 这一结果证明梯度匹配可服务于高效子集训练，但并未在等累计曝光 replay 条件下测量业务尾部收益。

results.claim: Warm start 和刷新周期不是装饰参数，而是显著影响小预算选择质量。
results.value: kappa=1/2 is reported best in the shown CIFAR-100 setting; too little warm start gives a poor initial state and too much approaches early stopping

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 低质量初始模型会污染梯度选择，过长 warm start 又会压缩真正选样训练的空间。

ablations: warm-start versus no warm-start and kappa sweep
regularization coefficient lambda and OMP tolerance epsilon
subset percentages from 1% to 30% depending on dataset
negative_results: GradMatch does not beat every baseline in every setting; GLISTER is better in the reported 30% imbalanced MNIST case.
Both very small lambda, including zero, and very large lambda reduce performance.
Small warm-start fractions produce poor starting models, while large fractions leave too little subset-selection training.
GLISTER and CRAIG could not run on ImageNet under the reported memory and runtime constraints.
failure_conditions: Last-layer or per-batch gradients do not preserve the target directions relevant to the downstream endpoint.
The target gradient is computed from a biased or reused validation set.
The model is too early in training for gradients to form a stable selection signal, or refresh is too sparse for the selected subset to remain relevant.
The selected gradient sum matches a global gradient but omits rare endpoint-critical modes that have small aggregate mass.
limitations: The paper optimizes subset-training efficiency, not additional replay under a fixed base-data pass and fixed cumulative replay exposure.
Gradient matching quality is a surrogate objective; the paper does not establish that better matching implies better FN95 safety or cross-seed replay utility.
Random is cardinality matched, but actual optimizer-visible exposures, repeated identities and augmentation draws are not matched to a Stage1 replay intervention.
Most experiments target full training gradients; validation-gradient matching is mainly used for class imbalance.
stage1_mechanism_zh: GradMatch supports testing A at the set level rather than ranking only by individual gradient norm: Stage1 can ask whether a bounded replay set approximates the independent FN95-critical target gradient, while holding current model state, cumulative exposures, base order and augmentations fixed. Last-layer embeddings are a cost-controlled first approximation, not the final truth criterion.
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文不能推出梯度和匹配误差最小的集合一定跨 seed 胜过随机，也不能把同 epoch 的子集训练称为同 replay 预算。它没有验证弱缺陷尾部、双阈值业务指标或 120,000 基础样本每轮恒定曝光；后续负结果还要求把 gradient-norm、positive-alignment 与匹配随机作为独立可证伪臂。
